title: Generative-AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor rentosertib shows FVC improvement in a 71-patient phase 2a IPF trial
summary: Phase 2a GENESIS-IPF trial in China: 60 mg daily rentosertib +98.4 mL FVC vs -20.3 mL placebo at 12 weeks; cohort-level, sponsor-run
account: Rentosertib, a TNIK inhibitor designed with Insilico Medicine's generative-AI platform, was tested in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2a trial (NCT05938920). It enrolled 71 patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis at 21 sites in China from 19 July 2023 to 11 June 2024 (paper). The registry lists 22 locations, a start date of 19 June 2023 and study completion on 8 August 2024. The primary endpoint was safety. Treatment-emergent adverse events were similar across arms. Patients on 60 mg once daily showed a mean forced vital capacity change of +98.4 mL versus -20.3 mL on placebo over 12 weeks. Insilico sponsored the trial. Eleven authors are its employees and the first author is at Peking Union Medical College Hospital. Results appeared in Nature Medicine on 3 June 2025. The authors call for larger, longer trials.
purpose: Rentosertib was designed as an antifibrotic treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The trial tested the safety and preliminary efficacy of exactly that intended benefit.
system: Insilico Medicine generative-AI drug discovery platform (target discovery and generative chemistry) that produced rentosertib (ISM001-055)
model_version: PandaOmics (Biology42) and Chemistry42, Insilico Pharma.AI platform
deployer: Insilico Medicine (trial sponsor) with 21 clinical centers in China

ratings.reason: The FVC improvement is a cohort mean from a 71-patient, 12-week, sponsor-run phase 2a trial with safety as the primary endpoint.
Any wider benefit depends on confirmation in larger, longer trials, which the authors themselves say are warranted.

ai_role.statement: The AI role is upstream: generative-AI tools identified TNIK as a target and designed the molecule. Any clinical effect is pharmacological. The trial was not powered for efficacy and FVC was not the primary endpoint. An independent network meta-analysis ranks rentosertib favorably on FVC decline but reports a non-significant trend toward more serious adverse events.

evidence.citation: Xu Z, et al.; Zhavoronkov A (2025). A generative AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a randomized phase 2a trial. Nature Medicine.
